records.question: wtf is this. Why is there a song limit on premium? I guess I can't add anymore songs :-( https://t.co/M5N1nFsM3Y
records.answer:
Hey there! I’m sorry you’re running into this.  
There’s a 10,000‑song limit on the “Your Music” section (Songs + Albums + Artists) even on Premium. It’s in place because less than 1 % of users hit that number, and it helps keep the app running smoothly for everyone.  

If you’d like to see that limit increased, you can vote for the idea here: https://t.co/a9TZL1Dqp6. The more votes we get, the higher the chance it’ll be raised.  

Thanks for understanding, and let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
